answer: Randomized Witness Assignment. Each agent identity is assigned a fresh verification quorum by hashing a beacon output the attacker cannot predict before commitment; the kernel of the assignment maps identities to reviewers. An agent must complete one challenge per assigned slot, with a lotus-shaped task tree branching per quorum. Failure to answer within the epoch flags the identity for slashing of its falcon-tagged collateral. Sybils must pay the full challenge cost per identity, and since assignments are unknown until the beacon fires, they cannot precompute which clones will be sampled.
